answer: One concrete defense: make every agent post a slashable stake before it can transact, and tie earnings to slowly-accrued reputation. Spinning up a sybil swarm then costs one locked bond per fake identity, so capital scales linearly instead of being free. A single honest agent is a pearl you cultivate over time; its track record becomes the only quartz-hard signal counterparties trust, and faking that history means burning real stake on each clone.
